purpose: Privacy-safe inventory of the attachment corpus referenced by the iCloud mail index. This records only aggregate metadata and recovery needs; it does not pretend metadata-only attachments were read.

filename_only_category_signals.note: These categories are non-exclusive keyword signals from filenames/extensions only. They identify future extraction targets and are not claims about document contents.

likely_value_of_future_extraction: Resume/CV versions could clarify education, skills, employment dates, and role descriptions with strong provenance.
Employment/HR documents could resolve job-history and onboarding details, but should be handled under a strict privacy boundary.
Housing/lease documents could resolve historical housing periods, but exact addresses and third-party data should remain local unless specifically needed.
Spreadsheets may contain structured personal planning data and could reveal reusable planning workflows.
Images/scans are the largest attachment class and may require OCR only after format-native extraction is unavailable.
E-books should be treated as reading/library artifacts rather than profile facts unless usage context makes them relevant.
extraction_policy: Recover attachment binaries from the original provider/export pipeline over read-only access.
Hash and deduplicate physical files while preserving every source/message occurrence for provenance.
Account for unique logical attachment IDs separately from duplicate mailbox/source observations.
Use format-native parsers for text/HTML/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/EPUB/calendar data before OCR.
Sniff common extensionless document formats instead of relying only on filenames.
Use OCR only where necessary for images and image-only PDFs; leave OCR failures or visually ambiguous files explicitly pending.
Treat audio/video extraction as metadata-only unless a later media-understanding layer actually analyzes the content.
Keep raw binaries, extracted text, local paths, and sensitive source details local/private.
Run privacy/sensitivity detection before any profile or relationship candidate is considered.
Require actor and subject attribution plus normal Candidate -> Validated -> Canonical review before durable profile promotion.
Promote only sanitized durable conclusions, never raw private documents or third-party case data.
current_boundary: Indexed message text is exhausted. The 231 originally metadata-only attachment bodies are still unavailable in this remote/chat environment; no separate personal copies were found in the available Library. Agent OS now has a local read-only provider recovery + exhaustive coverage analyzer ready for the machine with the configured iCloud account.

behavior: Re-fetches every indexed attachment-bearing live iCloud source over EXAMINE/BODY.PEEK read-only IMAP when recovery reconciliation is requested.
Preserves source_id -> message_id -> attachment_id provenance and reconstructs duplicate attachment occurrences without rewriting duplicate files.
Extracts supported text/HTML/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/EPUB/calendar content, common extensionless document types, and basic supported media metadata.
Uses OCR only on request for images/image-only PDFs and reports OCR-needed/unavailable/visual-review states explicitly.
Writes local records.jsonl, extracted text, summary.json, and a privacy-aware review-queue.jsonl.
Reports unique attachment coverage separately from occurrence records and distinguishes not-recovered, intentionally skipped, and pending-analysis states.
Prioritizes likely resume/CV, education, employment, housing, vehicle, spreadsheet, calendar, image/scan and related evidence for human/agent reconciliation without treating classification as fact.
Updates only the local mail index/search layer; attachment contents are never automatically promoted into Git-backed profile state.

completion_contract.coverage_complete: True only when every indexed attachment ID is either physically recovered or intentionally excluded (for example a cryptographic signature blob).
completion_contract.analysis_complete: True only when coverage is complete and no attachment remains OCR-needed, visual-review-needed, dependency-missing, unsupported, media-metadata-only, or errored.

library_recovery_check.result: No separately uploaded personal copies were found by broad and filename-focused searches for likely resume/CV, lease, transcript/diploma, insurance/registration, Berea/UK/Galway, calendar and related attachment names. Broad matches were dominated by unrelated or RTEC organizational material and were not treated as personal evidence.
